name: onboard
description: The onboarding app (shruggr/skein#90, #113), installed in the host skein. POST /onboard/call {fn: "onboard.create", args: {handle, image?, claim}} over any BRC-104 session (filter kernel.brc104, role user) asks the host's instance manager for a skein, passing the caller's own signed claim {message, body} (a message in box claim naming no recipient, shruggr/skein#127), which the manager forwards into it as its first entry: the claim grants root in the new skein to its signer; POST /onboard/register {username, identityKey, signature} (kernel.brc104, role user; signed over "register <username>@<domain>") asks it for a mailbox instance for the key. Each handle is certified through the host's certifier and recorded under onboard/handles/<handle>, and the app serves BRC-169 from those records by read routes (shruggr/skein#143: its filters answer — anyone, signed or not, nothing logged): /onboard/manifest.json, /onboard/resolve, /onboard/search, the paymail PKI at /onboard/bsvalias/id/ — with the holders' signed profiles (POST /onboard/profile: kernel.brc104, role user, the body signed by the handle's key: it writes). onboard.adopt (root's: a key holding root in the host skein) records and certifies a mailbox instance made before. config.onboard.domain is the host's one handle domain.
